subject: Private/VPC architecture review & readiness — pick a slot
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Morgan <alex.morgan@vitalbridge.io>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 1 Nov 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Private/VPC architecture review & readiness — pick a slot

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for the discovery call earlier today. Quick recap of what we heard from VitalBridge: data residency requirements for EU patients, separation of PHI-bound workloads, and the need for a secure peering pattern (no NAT over public internet). You also mentioned an internal procurement timeline targeting a pilot in Q1 and a compliance review in late January.

Next step: technical architecture review (deep dive) for Private/VPC/on-prem plan so we can validate network, IAM, and KMS requirements and produce a PoC runbook. Can your infra/security folks join? To make scheduling easy, here are three proposed windows (all durations ~60–75 minutes):

- Option A: Tue 8 Nov, 10:00–11:15 PT / 13:00–14:15 ET
- Option B: Wed 9 Nov, 08:00–09:15 PT / 11:00–12:15 ET
- Option C: Thu 10 Nov, 16:00–17:15 PT / 19:00–20:15 ET (works if you need EU-friendly hours)

Pre-call checklist (short):
- Confirm names and emails for the technical attendees (network, security, cloud ops).
- Share a rough CIDR plan or existing peering/firewall constraints (we attached a simple network diagram template).
- Confirm KMS preference (customer-managed KMS / HSM / Redwood-managed) and SSO provider (SAML/OIDC).
- Any restrictive egress rules (we need to know if outbound to our control plane is blocked).

Attachments: priv-vpc-arch-agenda.pdf (agenda + goals) and network-drawing-v1.png (sample template).

If you prefer, give me a single preferred option and I’ll lock a calendar invite and include Connor (solutions architect) and Rishi (ops lead) so we can cover SSO/KMS and deployment readiness.

Thanks — looking forward to the deep dive.

—
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
Office: +1 (415) 555-0187
From: Alex Morgan <alex.morgan@vitalbridge.io>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.patel@vitalbridge.io>
Date: Wed, 1 Nov 2028 10:05:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Private/VPC architecture review & readiness — pick a slot

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the clear recap. Option A (Tue 8 Nov, 10:00 PT) works best for our team. I’ll have Samir (cloud infra) and Lina Park (security) join — Lina is copied in separately from her alias but I will add her official address once I confirm with our admin.

Quick answers to your checklist:
- CIDR: we’ll send a 10.0.0.0/16 breakdown tomorrow — want to mark the private subnets we reserve for model hosts.
- KMS: leaning toward customer-managed KMS; we need to validate HSM requirements during the call.
- SSO: Okta (SAML)
- Egress: outbound to Redwood control plane is allowed but we will confirm the specific FQNs with Samir.

Please send the invite and we’ll confirm final attendee list. Looking forward to it.

Best,
Alex Morgan
Head of Cloud Architecture | VitalBridge Health
alex.morgan@vitalbridge.io
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Morgan <alex.morgan@vitalbridge.io>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 1 Nov 2028 10:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private/VPC architecture review & readiness — pick a slot

+1 on Option A — I’ll block time on our side. A couple of additions to the agenda so we’re focused:

- 10:00–10:10: Introductions and discovery recap (Marissa/Alex)
- 10:10–10:30: Network topology + peering requirements (Samir/Lina)
- 10:30–10:50: IAM, SSO, and KMS options (Okta integration and CMK details)
- 10:50–11:05: Deployment model variants (dedicated vs. private pools) and fallback plans
- 11:05–11:15: Actions and PoC next steps (ramps, commit, docs)

I’ll bring our SSO/KMS engineer (Rishi will cover ops constraints and runbook items). Can you confirm whether your environment requires IP allowlisting for our agent control-plane endpoints or whether you can use mutual TLS? If IP allowlisting is required, please include the CIDRs in the document Alex mentioned.

Perfect — Option A is locked. I’ve created a calendar invite for Tue 8 Nov 2028, 10:00–11:15 PT and attached the agenda for the deep dive (priv-vpc-arch-agenda.pdf). Connor and Rishi will join from Redwood. Alex, please add Lina Park and any other IP contacts to the invite when you have them.

Meeting logistics:

- Prep materials: I uploaded the sample network diagram template to the Drive link below; if you can drop your CIDR sketch there that’ll help Connor preview before the call.
